date_range: MGS MOLA (1997–2001) + Mars Express HRSC strips; exact HRSC dates: see product page
processing: Windowed read of the global 200 m blend; average-resampled to a 200 m local azimuthal-equidistant grid (Mars sphere R=3396190 m) ±5000 m around 43.33, -161.48; slope = arctan|∇z|; roughness = std of 3×3 residuals after removing the local plane; median of window
